title: SQL Stored Procedure Testing Companion
title_es: Companion de Testing de Stored Procedures SQL
description: Runnable SQL test scripts for stored procedures across SQL Server (tSQLt), PostgreSQL (pgTAP) and Oracle (utPLSQL) with GitHub Actions workflow for the QAPractices guide.
description_es: Scripts SQL ejecutables para testing de stored procedures en SQL Server (tSQLt), PostgreSQL (pgTAP) y Oracle (utPLSQL) con workflow de GitHub Actions para la guía de QAPractices.
